source_config.input_normalization: Divide by one RMS over all training activation elements; reuse for every split.
source_config.decoder_output: Multiply reconstruction by the training RMS to restore original units.
source_config.decoder_normalization: Unit L2 norm per column at initialization and after each optimizer step.
source_config.reconstruction_loss: Mean squared error in RMS-normalized units over examples and input dimensions.
source_config.sparsity_loss: Not applied; weighted_sparsity_loss is recorded as zero for compatibility.
source_config.auxiliary_loss: Training-only mean squared error against the detached RMS-normalized reconstruction residual, decoded without bias using eligible inactive features; zero when disabled or no features qualify.
source_config.auxiliary_eligibility: No positive main-path activation in the last aux_dead_window_examples training examples, measured after the current batch; disabled until the window has elapsed. Auxiliary activations do not reset counters.
source_config.auxiliary_metrics: Training auxiliary loss, weighted auxiliary loss, and eligible feature fraction are averaged with example weighting across batches.
source_config.auxiliary_effectiveness: train_auxiliary groups eligible fraction, measured_examples, positive features per example, positive encoder activation fraction across eligible feature/example pairs before auxiliary selection, prediction and residual RMS in normalized units, and 1 - auxiliary error SSE / residual SSE. Effectiveness uses only batches with eligible features; RMS and reduction use accumulated squared sums. Undefined values are null; negative reduction means worse than predicting zero.
source_config.early_stopping: Stop after patience epochs without validation loss decreasing by more than early_stopping_min_delta from the last significant improvement. The threshold is absolute, and smaller improvements accumulate. Checkpoint selection still saves the lowest validation loss.
source_config.selection_loss: Main-path validation loss, excluding AuxK; reconstruction loss for TopK and reconstruction plus weighted sparsity loss for L1.
source_config.variance_explained: 1 - reconstruction SSE / SSE around the training-mean activation; null if baseline SSE is zero.
source_config.persistent_inactivity: No positive activation in the last inactivity_window_examples training examples; null until that many examples have been observed. Evaluations do not update counters.
source_config.firing_frequencies: Fraction of examples with positive activation per feature; percentiles include unused features.
source_config.sparsity_mechanism: Per-example TopK of nonnegative encoder activations.

schedule: Optional step warmup to inherited LR, then constant; no scheduler or early stopping
seed_scope: Continuation order and resampling only; source training seed is unchanged
git_diff_scope: Staged and unstaged tracked changes relative to HEAD; untracked contents excluded.
